verdict.rationale: The docs confirm native mobile SDKs for iOS, Android and React Native that replace the Onfido Smart Capture SDKs and collect captures within workflow runs. For web, they show only a hosted Smart Capture Link journey, not a web SDK. Nothing in the pack describes the guided capture coaching that is the core of this story. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented web SDK, glare/blur/edge detection or real-time capture coaching, first-try capture quality claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
